name: coin-collecting-app
description: Coin Odyssey — coin collection manager for numismatists. Expo/React Native mobile app with a Supabase backend.
_comment_workspaces: web-app is deliberately NOT a workspace: it pins react@18, which npm hoists to the root and breaks react-native@0.81 (peer react@^19). It is retired from v1.0 — build it standalone with `cd web-app && npm install`.
author: Jason Alvarez
